title: Final Current Density
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the current density j.

title: Use of Poisson's Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Poisson equation in the context of the problem.

title: Energy Relation Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly use the energy relation between kinetic energy and electric potential.

title: Differential Equation Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should set up the differential equation correctly for the potential V.

title: Integration Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show correct integration steps leading to the final expression for j.

title: Sign and Factor Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors related to signs or missing factors in the final expression.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units are consistent throughout the solution.

title: Limiting Cases Consideration
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or special scenarios relevant to the problem.
